verdict.rationale: Stark Bank documents a self-serve Sandbox workspace that needs no sales contact. It also documents simulated sandbox behavior: 90% of sandbox Boletos are auto-paid within an hour. Production uses a separate base URL and separate credentials, which the SDKs select by environment, so tests stay off production data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, and an explicit statement on data isolation between the environments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Feel free to test our services in Sandbox by creating your workspace here (no need to contact us)
90% of the created Boletos in the Sandbox environment will be paid automatically within one hour.
Switching to Production requires you to change the base url and the credentials only. The SDKs select the base url according to the environment you choose.
